test_cases.title: Start of Mission tetikleyicisiyle oturum kurulumu (Level 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 2 modunda yapılandırılmıştır. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır. Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulabilir durumda.

steps.action: Start of Mission (SoM) prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteği gönderilir).

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar (Session Established Report).

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen emirle oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU aktif durumda, mevcut bir iletişim oturumu yok. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den OBU'ya iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, emri alır ve RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar.

test_cases.title: Manuel Level 2 değişimiyle oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU Level 1 veya başka bir seviyede çalışmaktadır. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.

steps.action: Sürücü, seviyeyi manuel olarak Level 2'ye değiştirir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar.

test_cases.title: Radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşınca oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bildirilmiş bir radyo deliğinin (radio hole) içinde veya hemen öncesinde. OBU Level 2'de.

steps.action: Trenin arka ucu, bildirilmiş radyo deliğinin sonuna ulaşır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kaybı sonrası oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile aktif bir iletişim oturumuna sahiptir. Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kesilebilir durumda.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kaybedilir ve mevcut oturum sonlandırılmış olarak kabul edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni bir iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar.

test_cases.title: SoM dışında manuel RBC seçimiyle oturum kurulumu
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission prosedürü dışında. Level 2'de. RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır.

steps.action: Sürücü, RBC iletişim bilgilerini manuel olarak seçer.
steps.expected: OBU, seçilen RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecini başlatır.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tamamlanana kadar beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumunun kurulduğunu raporlar.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu sıralaması ve başarılı tamamlanma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisiyle karşı karşıyadır. Uyumlu sistem sürümleri mevcuttur.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteği gönderir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduktan sonra beklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye 'Initiation of communication session' mesajı gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den sistem sürümü bilgisi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturumu kurulmuş olarak kabul eder ve RBC'ye 'Session Established Report' mesajı gönderir.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulum hatasında tekrar deneme
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisiyle karşı karşıyadır. İlk denemede bağlantı hatası simüle edilir.
test_cases.assumptions: SoM veya mod değişimi raporu dışında sınırsız tekrar deneme yapılabilir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır ve ilk güvenli radyo bağlantısı isteği başarısız olur.
steps.expected: OBU, EURORADIO'nun hatayı bildirmesinin hemen ardından yeni bir güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteği gönderir.

steps.action: İkinci denemede bağlantı başarılı olur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajı gönderir ve oturum kurulumu devam eder.

test_cases.title: Uyumsuz sistem sürümü durumunda oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma tetikleyicisiyle karşı karşıyadır. RBC, OBU'nun desteklemediği bir sistem sürümü gönderir.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu başlatılır ve güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulur.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Initiation of communication session' mesajı gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den uyumsuz sistem sürümü bilgisi alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, sürüm bağımsız mesaj olarak 'No compatible version supported' gönderir, sürücüyü bilgilendirir ve iletişim oturumunu sonlandırır.

test_cases.title: RBC emri önceliğiyle radyo sistemi seçimi (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R radyo sistemleri mevcuttur. RBC, FRMCS-only arayüze sahiptir. RBC'den oturum kurma emri gelir.

steps.action: RBC'den FRMCS-only RBC'ye iletişim oturumu kurma emri gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için FRMCS radyo sistemini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Sürücünün tek radyo tercihi önceliğiyle seçim
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. Kayıtlı Radio Network tipi FRMCS+GSM-R'dir. SoM sırasında sürücü tek radyo sistemi (GSM-R) seçmiştir. RBC emri yoktur.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tetiklenir (ör. manuel Level 2 değişimi).
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için sürücünün SoM'da seçtiği GSM-R radyo sistemini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı Radio Network bilgisiyle radyo sistemi seçimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. Kayıtlı Radio Network tipi FRMCS+GSM-R'dir. Tercih edilen radyo sistemi FRMCS'tir. RBC emri ve sürücü tek radyo tercihi yoktur.

steps.action: Oturum kurulumu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: OBU, güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu için kayıtlı tercih edilen radyo sistemi olan FRMCS'i kullanır.

test_cases.title: Başarılı bağlantı kurulan radyo sisteminin hafızaya alınması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da hem FRMCS hem GSM-R mevcuttur. Oturum kurulumu başlatılır.

steps.action: OBU, FRMCS radyo sistemini kullanarak güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurar.
steps.expected: OBU, başarılı bağlantı kurulumu için kullanılan radyo sistemini (FRMCS) hafızaya alır.

steps.action: OBU'nun hafıza durumu incelenir.
steps.expected: Hafızada son başarılı bağlantı için kullanılan radyo sistemi FRMCS olarak kayıtlıdır.

test_cases.title: SoM sırasında masa kapatılınca oturum kurulumunun iptali
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Start of Mission sırasında RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir (güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmuş veya kurulmaya çalışılıyor).

steps.action: Sürücü, Start of Mission sırasında masayı kapatır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulum sürecini iptal eder ve varsa güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: End of Mission sırasında oturum kurulumunun iptali
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir.

steps.action: End of Mission prosedürü başlatılır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulum sürecini iptal eder ve varsa güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: RBC'den gelen sonlandırma emriyle oturum kurulumunun iptali
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir.

steps.action: RBC'den iletişim oturumunu sonlandırma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulum sürecini iptal eder ve varsa güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Level 2 sınırını geçince oturum kurulumunun iptali
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC ile iletişim oturumu kurma sürecindedir. Tren, Level 2 desteklenmeyen bir alana doğru hareket etmektedir.

steps.action: Trenin minimum güvenli arka ucu, Level 2 alanından Level 2 desteklenmeyen alana geçiş sınırını geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, oturum kurulum sürecini iptal eder ve varsa güvenli radyo bağlantısını serbest bırakır.

test_cases.title: Son bilinen RBC emriyle telefon numarasının yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmıştır. RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren oturum kurma emri gelir.

steps.action: RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emirdeki telefon numarasını yok sayar ve saklanan RBC iletişim bilgilerini kullanarak RBC'ye bağlanır.

test_cases.title: Saklanan RBC bilgisi yoksa 'son bilinen RBC' emrinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU'da RBC iletişim bilgileri saklanmamıştır. RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' özel kimlik değerini içeren oturum kurma emri gelir.

steps.action: RBC'den 'son bilinen RBC' emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, emri yok sayar ve iletişim oturumu kurma işlemi başlatmaz.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (setup in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., Start of Mission or trackside order).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of detecting the state of the ongoing session.

steps.action: Initiate a process to establish a communication session with RBC-A while the first session with RBC-A is still being established.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The initial establishment process continues or is handled according to abort rules, but no second parallel session attempt is made.

test_cases.title: Prevention of new session with same RBC when session is active
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual level change or trackside order).

steps.action: Trigger a new communication session establishment with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish a session with RBC-B (not part of an RBC transition order embedded in a handover context that preserves the old session).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU supports multiple sessions or is configured to switch.

steps.action: Receive an order to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session establishment process with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Preservation of supervising RBC session during RBC transition order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A (Handing Over RBC) is established and active. OBU supports multiple simultaneous sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU is capable of handling more than one communication session through GSM-R.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an order to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Observe the session establishment process with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B while maintaining the session with RBC-A.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Shunting mode (Nominal direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Information from the balise group: 1) Valid for both directions, 2) Valid for Nominal direction only, 3) Valid for Reverse direction only.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction and receive information valid for both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction and receive information valid for Nominal direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Nominal direction and receive information valid for Reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information validity in Shunting mode (Reverse direction)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Nominal. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Information from the balise group: 1) Valid for both directions, 2) Valid for Reverse direction only, 3) Valid for Nominal direction only.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction and receive information valid for both directions.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction and receive information valid for Reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction and receive information valid for Nominal direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information.

test_cases.title: Retention of MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters (repetition period T1, trigger criteria) have been received from RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapsed since last MA request is less than T1. No new parameters received.

steps.action: Wait for a time interval less than the repetition period T1 without receiving new MA request parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously received MA request parameters.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request based on the old parameters (e.g., timer elapse or perturbation).
steps.expected: The MA request is sent using the old parameters.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receiving new parameters if repetition period elapsed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Current MA request parameters have repetition period T1. Time since last MA request is exactly T1.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters with repetition period T2 received from RBC.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC at the moment when the time since the last MA request is equal to the old repetition period T1.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's action immediately after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: No Supervised Location defined while Limit of Authority is supervised
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. The OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA data containing Overlap, Danger Point, and End Section information.

steps.action: Check the on-board Supervised Location (SvL) status while the LOA is being supervised.
steps.expected: No Supervised Location (SvL) is defined on-board. None of the candidates (end of overlap, Danger Point, end of End Section) are used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Validity of Level 1 signalling speed restriction until new one is received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction (SR1) with value V1 has been received and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new signalling related speed restriction received initially. Then a new signalling related speed restriction (SR2) with value V2 is received.

steps.action: Operate the train for a period without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the speed restriction V1.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction SR2 with value V2.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the previous restriction V1 with the new restriction V2.

test_cases.title: Validity of Level 1 signalling speed restriction after switch to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction (SR1) with value V1 is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Level transition to Level 2. Level 2 MA not yet accepted.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction V1 remains valid.

steps.action: Operate in Level 2 before accepting a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the speed restriction V1.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 MA.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction V1 is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 MA supervision).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific Maximum Train Speed (MTS) value reflecting the train's performance.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed approaching the configured MTS.

steps.action: Increase the train speed towards the configured Maximum Train Speed.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Maximum Train Speed as a Static Speed Restriction and limits the train speed accordingly.

test_cases.title: Initial state of speed restrictions allows full braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restrictions have been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed increasing.

steps.action: Observe the speed supervision logic in the initial state before any trackside speed restriction is computed.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed. The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is applying a speed restriction computed from trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.

steps.action: Receive a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU stops applying the previous speed restriction.

steps.action: Observe the speed supervision logic after the order.
steps.expected: No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed. The OBU reverts to the 'no speed restriction' state.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is active via a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system used for the initial connection is available and functional for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection by sending a 'loss of safe radio connection' indication from EURORADIO to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection using the same radio system previously used.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's radio interface activity.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection setup request is observed on the correct radio system interface.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts continue until connection is established
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Simulated successful reconnection after a delay.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination (A.3.1) is longer than the simulated reconnection delay.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait for a duration shorter than the defined session termination time, during which the connection remains lost.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to send repeated requests to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the successful establishment of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts and proceeds with the session establishment procedure (e.g., sending Initiation of communication session).

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated due to timeout
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. No reconnection success.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination (A.3.1) is known and can be monitored or simulated.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Wait until the defined time for session termination expires without a successful reconnection.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the session as terminated and stops the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists. The safe radio connection is lost. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection. Train movement simulation passing the specified location.
test_cases.assumptions: The train position can be simulated to pass the location indicated in the RIU order before the session termination timeout expires.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts and considers the session as terminated.

test_cases.title: OBU initiates termination upon explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the RBC.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to terminate session.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of communication session' order from the trackside (RBC) to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination procedure by sending a 'Termination of communication session' message to the trackside.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without valid trigger
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. No trackside order is received and no internal termination condition is met.

steps.action: Wait for a duration longer than the fixed waiting time without sending any trackside order or triggering internal conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send a 'Termination of communication session' message and the session remains active.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats termination message when no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has sent a 'Termination of communication session' message. The trackside is configured to not send an acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time and repetition count are defined in Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after the first 'Termination of communication session' message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a second 'Termination of communication session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after the second message without receiving an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a third 'Termination of communication session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after max repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in the process of terminating a session and has already repeated the 'Termination of communication session' message the defined number of times (max repetitions).
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside does not send any acknowledgement.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after the last allowed repetition of the 'Termination of communication session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated and stops sending further termination messages.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The GSM-R Radio Network is available.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration after driver enters new network identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and registered to a GSM-R Radio Network. The driver interface is accessible.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Enter a new GSM-R Radio Network identity via the driver interface.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the new GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobile Terminal registration when ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The trackside is configured to send a Radio Network transition order.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Send a Radio Network transition order from trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the order and initiates the registration process for the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

steps.action: Monitor the GSM-R Mobile Terminal status.
steps.expected: The GSM-R Mobile Terminal becomes registered to the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Use of default Radio Network type when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. The OBU's non-volatile memory is cleared to simulate a state with no memorised Radio Network type (e.g., after System Failure or first power-up).
test_cases.assumptions: The default Radio Network type is configured on-board as 'GSM-R'.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the absence of a memorised Radio Network type.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state or logs for the active Radio Network type.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type ('GSM-R') configured on-board.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request to RBC when FRMCS is not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is 'FRMCS'. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request to RBC when FRMCS is not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, driver chose FRMCS)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. The stored Radio Network type is 'FRMCS+GSM-R'. The driver has elected to perform the mission with FRMCS only. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request to RBC when neither FRMCS nor GSM-R is registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, no single-radio choice)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. The stored Radio Network type is 'FRMCS+GSM-R'. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request to RIU when GSM-R is not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but is NOT registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'No Connection' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where no safe radio connection is established with any RBC/RIU.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status indication.
steps.expected: The display shows the status 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Up' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where a safe radio connection is being established with a relevant RBC/RIU.

steps.action: Simulate the successful setup of a safe radio connection with the RBC/RIU.
steps.expected: The driver display changes to show the status 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Indication of 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where a safe radio connection is established ('Connection Up').

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection and ensure the connection status timer expires.
steps.expected: The driver display changes to show the status 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Timer start on first session establishment request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in 'No Connection' state. The driver initiates the Start of Mission procedure.

steps.action: Trigger the first request to set up a safe radio connection for session establishment (e.g., via Start of Mission).
steps.expected: The internal 'connection status' timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Timer start on first session maintenance request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in 'No Connection' state. A condition requiring session maintenance (e.g., periodic position report or specific trigger per §3.5.4.2/4.4) is active.

steps.action: Trigger the first request to set up a safe radio connection for maintaining a communication session.
steps.expected: The internal 'connection status' timer starts counting.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'No Connection'.

steps.action: Simulate the successful setup of the safe radio connection (Condition [4]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions directly to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Connection to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'No Connection'. The Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: Simulate the final attempt to set up the safe radio connection failing (Condition [1]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up'.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection (Condition [6] part 1) and stop requests for reasons other than successful setup (Condition [6] part 2).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Lost/Set-Up failed to Connection Up
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

steps.action: Simulate the successful setup of the safe radio connection (Condition [4]).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'Connection Up'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Connection Up to No Connection
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU indicates 'Connection Up'. No Start of Mission procedure is ongoing.

steps.action: Simulate the release of the safe radio connection (Condition [5]) and stop requests for reasons other than successful setup (Condition [3] part 2).
steps.expected: The indication status transitions to 'No Connection'.

test_cases.title: Indication of current infill area RIU status
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has safe radio connections with multiple Radio Infill Units (RIUs). The train is located in an infill area served by RIU-A.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status.
steps.expected: The display shows the status corresponding to the connection with RIU-A (the current infill area), not RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Invalid train position becomes valid after passing LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'invalid'. The train is moving towards a linked balise group (LRBG).
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is correctly identified as LRBG compliant.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'invalid'.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the train position is invalid.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the LRBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status after passing the LRBG.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. The previously stored invalid position data is deleted/replaced with the new valid position relative to the LRBG.

test_cases.title: Unknown train position becomes valid after passing ORBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'unknown' (no position stored). The train is moving towards a known ORBG.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group is a valid ORBG reference.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status is 'unknown'.
steps.expected: The OBU indicates the train position is unknown.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the ORBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status after passing the ORBG.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. A valid train position is now stored on-board relative to the ORBG.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab A is active. The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.

steps.action: Activate Cab A and verify the active cab status.
steps.expected: Cab A is reported as the active cab.

steps.action: Check the defined train orientation.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined such that the side of Cab A is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train has two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab B was the last active cab. Currently, no cab is active.

steps.action: Deactivate all cabs so that no cab is active.
steps.expected: The OBU reports that no cab is currently active.

steps.action: Check the defined train orientation.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined by the last active cab (Cab B). The side of Cab B is considered the front of the train.

test_cases.title: Estimated front end used for location-based supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The OBU is supervising a location-based event (e.g., a speed restriction start point) that does not specify a different reference in SUBSET-026.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is distinct from the max safe front end and min safe rear end.

steps.action: Configure a location-based supervision event that uses the default reference (estimated front end).
steps.expected: The OBU is configured to use the estimated front end for this event.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end passes the event location.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the supervision action (e.g., applies speed restriction) based on the estimated front end passing the location.

test_cases.title: Max safe front end used for End Section timer start
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an End Section. The OBU is configured to start the End Section timer when the max safe front end passes the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The max safe front end is ahead of the estimated front end.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end passes the End Section start location, but the max safe front end has not yet passed it.
steps.expected: The End Section timer does NOT start.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the max safe front end passes the End Section start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts.

test_cases.title: Min safe rear end used for RBC/RBC border crossing
test_cases.preconditions: The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border. The OBU is configured to report the border crossing when the min safe rear end passes the border location.
test_cases.assumptions: The min safe rear end is behind the estimated front end.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end passes the RBC/RBC border, but the min safe rear end has not yet passed it.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT report the border crossing as complete.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the min safe rear end passes the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU reports the border crossing as complete.

test_cases.title: RBC'ye LRBGONB referanslı konum raporu gönderimi
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılan ve bağlantı bilgilerinde ilan edilen bir LRBG uyumlu balise grubunu geçmiştir. Balise grubunun içeriği işlenmiştir.

steps.action: Trenin RBC'ye konum raporu göndermesi beklenir.
steps.expected: Gönderilen mesajda LRBG kimliği, son geçilen LRBG uyumlu balise grubunun kimliğiyle eşleşir.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen ve bu LRBG'ye referans veren bir mesaj (örneğin M3) gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı kabul eder ve konum bilgisini günceller.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmadığında LRBG uyumluluğu
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılmayan bir bölgededir. Son geçilen balise grubu 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmemiştir.

steps.action: Tren, 'unlinked' olarak işaretlenmemiş bir balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, bu balise grubunu LRBG uyumlu olarak kabul eder.

steps.action: Trenin RBC'ye konum raporu göndermesi beklenir.
steps.expected: Gönderilen mesajda LRBG kimliği, bu 'unlinked' olmayan balise grubunun kimliğiyle eşleşir.

test_cases.title: LRBG uyumlu olmayan balise grubunun referans olarak kullanılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren, bağlantı tutarlılığı kontrolü yapılan bir bölgededir. Son geçilen balise grubu 'linked' olarak işaretlenmemiştir veya bağlantı bilgilerinde ilan edilmemiştir.

steps.action: Tren, LRBG uyumlu olmayan bir balise grubunu geçer.
steps.expected: OBU, bu balise grubunu LRBGONB olarak kabul etmez.

steps.action: Trenin RBC'ye konum raporu göndermesi beklenir.
steps.expected: Gönderilen mesajda LRBG kimliği, bu son geçilen balise grubunun kimliği değildir (önceki geçerli LRBGONB veya 'unknown' kullanılır).

test_cases.title: Son raporlanan LRBG'lerden birine referans veren RBC mesajının kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye en az 8 LRBGONB raporlamıştır. RBC, bu LRBG'lerden birine (örneğin 5. sonuncu) referans veren bir mesaj gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'den birine referans veren bir mesaj (örneğin M3) gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı kabul eder ve konum bilgisini bu referans balise grubuna göre günceller.

test_cases.title: Son raporlanan LRBG'lerin dışındaki bir LRBG'ye referans veren RBC mesajının reddi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC'ye en az 8 LRBGONB raporlamıştır. RBC, bu 8 LRBG'nin dışındaki (örneğin 9. sonuncu) bir LRBG'ye referans veren bir mesaj gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den, son raporlanan 8 LRBGONB'nin dışındaki bir LRBG'ye referans veren bir mesaj (örneğin M3) gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, mesajı reddeder veya konum bilgisini bu referansla güncellemez.

test_cases.title: Tren konumu bilinmediğinde LRBG kimliğinin 'unknown' olarak raporlanması
test_cases.preconditions: Tren konumu bilinmemektedir veya SoM prosedürü sırasında konum verileri silinmiştir.

steps.action: Trenin RBC'ye konum raporu (SoM position report) göndermesi beklenir.
steps.expected: Gönderilen mesajda LRBG kimliği 'unknown' olarak ayarlanır.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores information valid for the opposite direction
test_cases.preconditions: The train is moving in the nominal direction. The OBU is in a mode where it processes trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A trackside message (e.g., from a balise or radio) containing valid data for the reverse direction only.

steps.action: Transmit a message to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the reverse direction only.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the message. No state change or action is triggered by this data.

steps.action: Transmit a message to the OBU that is explicitly marked as valid for the nominal direction.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the message and updates its internal state accordingly.

test_cases.title: OBU rejects one-direction data when orientation is unknown
test_cases.preconditions: The train orientation cannot be related to the direction of the trackside device (e.g., unknown balise group crossing direction for SL/PS/SH engines).
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. A message valid for the nominal direction only. 2. A message valid for both directions.

steps.action: Transmit a message valid for the nominal direction only to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data.

steps.action: Transmit a message valid for both directions to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates and accepts the data.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: incremental distances and last value validity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received a continuous profile with a specific speed limit (e.g., 100 km/h) valid up to a certain distance.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new continuous profile message containing: Value 1 (120 km/h) with Distance 2 (500m), Value 2 (80 km/h) with Distance 3 (0m).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'previously received data' for the first distance segment is known and valid.

steps.action: Transmit the new continuous profile message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the profile such that the previously received speed limit applies for the first distance segment (Distance 1).

steps.action: Check the speed limit applied for the segment corresponding to Distance 2 (500m).
steps.expected: The speed limit is 120 km/h (Value 1) for this segment.

steps.action: Check the speed limit applied for the segment corresponding to Distance 3 (0m).
steps.expected: The speed limit is 80 km/h (Value 2) for this segment, even though the distance is 0.

steps.action: Check the speed limit applied for any distance beyond the last transmitted value (Value 2).
steps.expected: The speed limit remains 80 km/h (Value 2) indefinitely, as it is not an 'end of profile' value.

test_cases.title: Continuous profile data interpretation: End-of-profile value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive a continuous profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: A continuous profile message where the last value is the special 'end of profile' value.

steps.action: Transmit a continuous profile message ending with the 'end of profile' value.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets the profile such that the last value is valid only up to the end of the profile, and does not extend indefinitely.

test_cases.title: Location data interpretation: unsigned incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received location data.
test_cases.test_inputs: A location data message with two values: Value 1 (Location A) with Distance 2 (100m), Value 2 (Location B) with Distance 3 (200m).

steps.action: Transmit the location data message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 2 as the distance from the start of the previous data segment to Location A.

steps.action: Check the distance interpretation for Location B.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 3 as the distance from Location A to Location B.

steps.action: Check the data applied for the first distance segment (Distance 1).
steps.expected: The previously received location data is used for the first distance segment.

test_cases.title: Non-continuous profile data interpretation: overlapping elements
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has previously received non-continuous profile data or has default values.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-continuous profile message with two elements: Element 1 (Value 1, Length 100m) with Distance 2 (50m), Element 2 (Value 2, Length 100m) with Distance 3 (20m).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'previously received data' for the first distance is known.

steps.action: Transmit the non-continuous profile message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 2 (50m) as the distance from the start of the previous element to the start of Element 1.

steps.action: Check the start position of Element 2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 3 (20m) as the distance from the start of Element 1 to the start of Element 2.

steps.action: Verify the overlap between Element 1 and Element 2.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts that Element 2 starts 20m after Element 1, while Element 1 has a length of 100m, resulting in an overlap of 80m.

test_cases.title: Linking information interpretation: distances to balise groups
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is ready to receive linking information.
test_cases.test_inputs: A linking information message with three balise groups: BG1, BG2, BG3. Distance 1 (100m to BG1), Distance 2 (200m between BG1 and BG2), Distance 3 (300m between BG2 and BG3).

steps.action: Transmit the linking information message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 1 (100m) as the distance to the first announced balise group (BG1).

steps.action: Check the distance interpretation for BG2.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 2 (200m) as the distance between BG1 and BG2.

steps.action: Check the distance interpretation for BG3.
steps.expected: The OBU interprets Distance 3 (300m) as the distance between BG2 and BG3.

steps.action: Check the linking data associated with each balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU associates the correct linking data with BG1, BG2, and BG3 respectively.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A balise group (BG-A) is detected.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing location accuracy for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking information is valid and consistent.

steps.action: Detect BG-A and receive linking information that specifies a location accuracy value for BG-A.
steps.expected: The OBU assigns the location accuracy of BG-A to the value specified in the linking information.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is absent
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy for the current reference BG.
test_cases.test_inputs: A National Value for location accuracy is configured for the current area.
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value is applicable to the current location.

steps.action: Allow the current reference balise group to become LRBG or ORBG without prior determination of location accuracy via linking.
steps.expected: The OBU assigns the location accuracy of the balise group to the applicable National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information has determined the location accuracy. No National Value is applicable for the current area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Default Value for location accuracy is configured.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value is the fallback when National Value is not applicable.

steps.action: Allow the current reference balise group to become LRBG or ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU assigns the location accuracy of the balise group to the Default Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated upon further linking information
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of a balise group (BG-A) has been determined (e.g., via linking).
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information containing a different location accuracy value for BG-A.
test_cases.assumptions: BG-A is still the reference or relevant BG.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that specifies a different location accuracy for BG-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-A; it retains the previously determined value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of a balise group (BG-A) has been determined. Linking consistency checking is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A condition that causes linking consistency checking to stop (e.g., loss of linking data).
test_cases.assumptions: The change in linking status does not trigger a re-evaluation of location accuracy for already determined BGs.

steps.action: Cause the OBU to stop checking linking consistency.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-A.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: The location accuracy of a balise group (BG-A) has been determined. The train moves into an area where a different National Value for location accuracy applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: Change of area triggering a new National Value.
test_cases.assumptions: The new National Value is different from the one used to determine BG-A's accuracy.

steps.action: Move the train into an area where a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the location accuracy of BG-A; it retains the previously determined value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval delimitation calculation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an estimated train front end position, a reference balise group with known location accuracy, and known over/under-reading amounts.
test_cases.test_inputs: Known values for location accuracy, over-reading amount, under-reading amount, and estimated front end position.
test_cases.assumptions: No consist-length-related situations are active (gamma term is zero or not applicable).

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position as: Estimated Front End - (Location Accuracy + Over-reading Amount).
steps.expected: The OBU sets the min safe front end position to the calculated value, which is in rear of the estimated front end.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position as: Estimated Front End + (Location Accuracy + Under-reading Amount).
steps.expected: The OBU sets the max safe front end position to the calculated value, which is in advance of the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is being checked. Multiple balise groups have been received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information that references or announces a specific balise group (BG-X) as the most recent relevant one.
test_cases.assumptions: BG-X is the most recently received BG that is either the reference of or announced in linking information.

steps.action: Receive linking information that references or announces BG-X.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the SOLR to BG-X.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not being checked. Multiple balise groups have been received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Detection of a new balise group (BG-Y).
test_cases.assumptions: BG-Y is the last received balise group.

steps.action: Detect BG-Y while linking consistency is not checked.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the SOLR to BG-Y.

test_cases.title: Linking replacement rule applied before SOLR update
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking information is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information that triggers a change in SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) is defined and applicable.

steps.action: Receive linking information that would change the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule before updating the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Relocation before replacement rule for non-linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Non-linking location-based information is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location-based information referred to a BG different from the current SOLR.
test_cases.assumptions: The information requires relocation to the SOLR before processing.

steps.action: Receive non-linking location-based information referred to a BG other than the SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the SOLR before applying the corresponding replacement rule.

test_cases.title: Processing location-based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU receives location-based information from trackside.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location-based information that can be decomposed into min, estimated, and max items.
test_cases.assumptions: The information type is associated with specific location item types in SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

steps.action: Process the received location-based information.
steps.expected: The OBU creates up to three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

steps.action: Apply the clause associated with the information type using the corresponding location item.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the correct location item (min, estimated, or max) as specified in SUBSET-026 Table 2a for the given information type.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using linking distance
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group (BG-New) becomes the SOLR. Location items are referred to a former reference BG (BG-Old). Linking information provides the distance between BG-Old and BG-New.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location items with distances relative to BG-Old. Linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New.
test_cases.assumptions: The last relocation of the location items was not performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG.

steps.action: Relocate the location items to the new SOLR (BG-New) by subtracting the linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New from their distances.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the distances of the location items relative to BG-New by subtracting the linking distance.

test_cases.title: Relocation of location items to new SOLR using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group (BG-New) becomes the SOLR. Location items are referred to a former reference BG (BG-Old). Linking information is not available or not applicable for the distance between BG-Old and BG-New.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location items with distances relative to BG-Old. Travelled distance between BG-Old and BG-New computed from train front end positions.
test_cases.assumptions: The travelled distance is computed as per clauses 3.6.1.3 and 3.6.4.1.5.

steps.action: Relocate the location items to the new SOLR (BG-New) by subtracting the travelled distance between BG-Old and BG-New from their distances.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the distances of the location items relative to BG-New by subtracting the travelled distance.

test_cases.title: Relocation of min location items with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group (BG-New) becomes the SOLR. A 'min' location item is referred to a former reference BG (BG-Old). The last relocation was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'min' location item with distance relative to BG-Old. Linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New. Location accuracy of BG-Old.
test_cases.assumptions: The adjustment for 'min' items is to diminish the distance by twice the location accuracy of the FRBG.

steps.action: Relocate the 'min' location item to the new SOLR (BG-New) by subtracting the linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New, diminished by twice the location accuracy of BG-Old.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the distance of the 'min' location item relative to BG-New by subtracting (Linking Distance - 2 * Location Accuracy of BG-Old).

test_cases.title: Relocation of max location items with location accuracy adjustment
test_cases.preconditions: A balise group (BG-New) becomes the SOLR. A 'max' location item is referred to a former reference BG (BG-Old). The last relocation was performed per clause 3.6.4.2.5 c) towards a BG not received earlier than the reference BG.
test_cases.test_inputs: A 'max' location item with distance relative to BG-Old. Linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New. Location accuracy of BG-Old.
test_cases.assumptions: The adjustment for 'max' items is to augment the distance by twice the location accuracy of the FRBG.

steps.action: Relocate the 'max' location item to the new SOLR (BG-New) by subtracting the linking distance between BG-Old and BG-New, augmented by twice the location accuracy of BG-Old.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the distance of the 'max' location item relative to BG-New by subtracting (Linking Distance + 2 * Location Accuracy of BG-Old).

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by reaching standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is moving. RBC has requested position reports.

steps.action: Bring the train to a complete standstill.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by leaving standstill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is at standstill.

steps.action: Start the train moving from standstill.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by mode change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode (e.g., Full Supervision).

steps.action: Change the OBU mode (e.g., to Shunting or Standby).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by level change
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2.

steps.action: Trigger a level change (e.g., to Level 1 or Level 0).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is not currently in a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: Establish a successful communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by passing LRBG without stored parameters
test_cases.preconditions: No position report parameters are stored on-board. The train is approaching an LRBG compliant balise group.

steps.action: Pass the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reporting with confirmed length
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity is confirmed by the driver. Valid train length data is available.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Confirmed by driver' and the confirmed train length value.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reporting without length when no integrity info
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'No train integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'No train integrity information' and does NOT contain confirmed train length information.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status reporting when integrity lost
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'Integrity lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains train integrity status 'Integrity lost' and does NOT contain confirmed train length information.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by Driver
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'No integrity information'. Train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available and acknowledged by RBC. No new Train Data pending validation.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The train integrity status transitions to 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by External Source
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Receive 'Train integrity confirmed' information from an external source.
steps.expected: The train integrity status transitions to 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition to Integrity Lost upon Train Data invalidation
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Change Train Data status from valid to invalid.
steps.expected: The train integrity status transitions to 'Integrity lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition to No Integrity upon new session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity status is 'Confirmed by driver'. A new communication session with an RBC is established.

steps.action: Establish a new communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The train integrity status is initially set to 'No integrity information' for this RBC.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where geographical position data is available (e.g., after passing a reference balise group). The geographical position display is currently inactive.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the driver interface.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the display.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the train's estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position display is currently active and visible on the driver interface.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is currently displayed.
steps.expected: The geographical position is visible on the display.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The train has passed a geographical reference balise group. The OBU has stored the track kilometre reference for this location. The train has travelled a known distance D from the reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Known distance D travelled from the reference location.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value at the reference location is known (e.g., TK_ref). The counting direction is consistent.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position after travelling distance D from the reference location.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position corresponds to TK_ref + D (or TK_ref - D depending on counting direction), confirming that the distance travelled since the reference location is added to the calculation.

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Roll Away Protection upon supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a state where Roll Away Protection supervision can be initiated (e.g., Standstill). The National/Default Value for maximum distance is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away distance: 100 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for diagnostic or test observation purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the supervision for Roll Away Protection.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance as 100 m (National Value - 0 m travelled).

steps.action: Simulate train movement of 20 m in the supervised direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 80 m.

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Post Trip reversing distance upon supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Post Trip mode. The National/Default Value for maximum reversing distance is configured.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for reversing distance: 50 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for diagnostic or test observation purposes.

steps.action: Initiate the supervision for reversing in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance as 50 m.

steps.action: Simulate train movement of 10 m in the reversing direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 40 m.

test_cases.title: Calculation of remaining distance for Staff Responsible maximum distance upon supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is entering Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The maximum permitted distance is determined by a National/Default Value.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for SR distance: 200 m. Initial estimated position: 0 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU exposes the calculated remaining distance for diagnostic or test observation purposes.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode, triggering the start of SR distance supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and stores the remaining distance as 200 m.

steps.action: Simulate train movement of 50 m in the supervised direction.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 150 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Roll Away distance using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Roll Away Protection supervision is active. The OBU is tracking the estimated distance travelled from the start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for Roll Away distance: 100 m. Odometer reading: 0 m at start.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled (based on odometer) to update the remaining distance.

steps.action: Simulate train movement such that the estimated distance travelled is 30 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 70 m (100 m - 30 m).

steps.action: Simulate further train movement such that the total estimated distance travelled is 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 0 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Trip Suppression distance after Override using estimated distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: Override function has been triggered. The supervision for trip suppression distance is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for trip suppression distance: 150 m. Odometer reading: 0 m at Override trigger.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the estimated distance travelled since Override trigger to update the remaining distance.

steps.action: Simulate train movement such that the estimated distance travelled since Override is 50 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 100 m (150 m - 50 m).

steps.action: Simulate further train movement such that the total estimated distance travelled since Override is 150 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance as 0 m.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance with virtual train front position and odometer correction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. The SR distance is determined by a National/Default Value. The OBU is managing a virtual train front position.
test_cases.test_inputs: National/Default Value for SR distance: 200 m. Odometer under-reading amount: 5 m. Odometer over-reading amount: 5 m. Estimated distance travelled: 100 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates three remaining distances: from estimated front end, from max safe front end, and from min safe front end.

steps.action: Simulate train movement such that the estimated distance travelled is 100 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated front end as 100 m (200 m - 100 m).

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end as 95 m (200 m - 100 m - 5 m under-reading).

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the min safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end as 105 m (200 m - 100 m + 5 m over-reading).

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: Override function has been triggered in SB or PT mode while there was no valid train position stored on-board. The OBU is supervising a zero distance to the former EOA/LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised distance: 0 m. Estimated distance travelled: 10 m. Odometer under-reading: 2 m. Odometer over-reading: 2 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends.

steps.action: Simulate train movement such that the estimated distance travelled is 10 m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the estimated front end as -10 m (0 m - 10 m).

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the max safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the max safe front end as -12 m (0 m - 10 m - 2 m under-reading).

steps.action: Check the remaining distance from the min safe front end.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance from the min safe front end as -8 m (0 m - 10 m + 2 m over-reading).

test_cases.title: MA reddi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, F-OP (Full Supervision) modunda çalışmaktadır. Araç konumu ve güven aralığı belirlenmiştir. RBC'den gelen MA, araç ön ucundan denetlenen konuma (supervised location) kadar uzanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA mesajı (Supervised Location: 1000m, Train Front: 0m). SSP verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 800m). Eğim verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 800m).
test_cases.assumptions: SSP ve eğim verileri, MA ile birlikte veya daha önce OBU'da mevcut olan verilerdir. 'Full length' tanımı, araç ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadarki mesafedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (0m-1000m) kapsamadığı (sadece 0m-800m'yi kapsadığı) bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA mesajını ve ilişkili mod profillerini (varsa) reddeder. MA, OBU'da kabul edilmez ve uygulanmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı ve hata kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA reddinin nedeni olarak SSP/eğim eksikliği veya benzeri bir hata kodu/kaydı görülebilir. Araç, mevcut MA'siz durumuna veya önceki güvenli duruma döner/kalır.

test_cases.title: MA reddi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, F-OP modundadır. Mevcut bir MA vardır. RBC'den bir infill (doldurma) MA'sı gönderilecektir. Infill konumu referansı (infill location reference) 500m'dir. Denetlenen konum (supervised location) 1500m'dir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA mesajı (Infill Ref: 500m, Supervised Location: 1500m). SSP verisi (Kapsam: 500m - 1200m). Eğim verisi (Kapsam: 500m - 1200m).
test_cases.assumptions: Infill MA için 'full length', infill konumu referansından denetlenen konuma kadarki mesafedir (500m-1500m).

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verilerinin infill MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (500m-1500m) kapsamadığı (sadece 500m-1200m'yi kapsadığı) bir infill MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, infill MA mesajını ve ilişkili mod profillerini reddeder. Infill işlemi tamamlanmaz.

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut MA durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Önceki geçerli MA durumu korunur veya sistem güvenli bir duruma geçer. Reddedilen infill MA uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: MA reddi: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Supervised Manoeuvre, ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Supervised Manoeuvre (SM) moduna geçiş hazırlığındadır veya SM modundadır. MA'nın geçerlilik yönü, mevcut araç yönünün tersinedir. Yeni araç yönüne göre tahmini araç ön ucu 0m'dir. Denetlenen konum 2000m'dir.
test_cases.test_inputs: SM MA mesajı (Validity Direction: Opposite, New Train Front: 0m, Supervised Location: 2000m). SSP verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 1500m). Eğim verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 1500m).
test_cases.assumptions: SM modunda ve ters yön MA için 'full length', yeni araç yönüne göre tahmini araç ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadarki mesafedir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (0m-2000m) kapsamadığı (sadece 0m-1500m'yi kapsadığı) bir SM MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA mesajını ve ilişkili mod profillerini reddeder.

steps.action: OBU'nun mod durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: SM moduna geçiş yapılmaz veya mevcut SM durumu güvenli bir şekilde sonlandırılır/korunur. Reddedilen MA uygulanmaz.

test_cases.title: MA kabulü: SSP ve eğim MA uzunluğunu tam kapsıyor (Normal)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, F-OP modundadır. Araç konumu ve güven aralığı belirlenmiştir. RBC'den gelen MA, araç ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar uzanmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA mesajı (Supervised Location: 1000m, Train Front: 0m). SSP verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 1000m). Eğim verisi (Kapsam: 0m - 1000m).
test_cases.assumptions: SSP ve eğim verileri, MA ile birlikte veya daha önce OBU'da mevcut olan verilerdir ve MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamaktadır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve eğim verilerinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (0m-1000m) kapsadığı bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA mesajını ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul eder. MA, OBU'da uygulanır ve denetim başlar.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA'nın uygulandığına dair uygun göstergeler (hız limiti, mesafe vb.) görülmektedir. Hata kaydı oluşmamıştır.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Static Speed Profile from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has stored Static Speed Profile information for a section of track ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Static Speed Profile message with a start location within the range of the stored profile.

steps.action: Transmit a new Static Speed Profile message to the OBU with a start location located within the existing stored profile range.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored Static Speed Profile information from the start location of the new information onwards. The profile before the start location remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Non-Infill) from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information associated with a specific reference balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: New non-infill linking information message with a reference balise group matching the stored one.

steps.action: Transmit new non-infill linking information to the OBU where the reference balise group matches the one of the stored linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new linking information.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Infill) from infill reference location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information associated with a specific infill reference location (balise group at next main signal).
test_cases.test_inputs: New infill linking information message with a reference location matching the stored infill location.

steps.action: Transmit new infill linking information to the OBU where the reference location matches the stored infill reference location.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference location of the infill information.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Station Platform track condition from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Station Platform track condition information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Station Platform track condition message with a start location.

steps.action: Transmit new Station Platform track condition information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored Station Platform information from the start location of the first element of the new information.

test_cases.title: Complete replacement of Allowed Current Consumption
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Allowed Current Consumption information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Allowed Current Consumption track condition message.

steps.action: Transmit new Allowed Current Consumption track condition information to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored Allowed Current Consumption information completely.

test_cases.title: Resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond a specific location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for stored PBD speed restriction information beyond a given location.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the PBD speed restriction information beyond the specified location. Information before the location remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Resume initial state for Axle Load Speed Profile beyond a location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Axle Load Speed Profile information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond a specific location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for stored axle load speed profile information beyond a given location.
