steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the axle load speed profile information beyond the specified location. Information before the location remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Single request to resume initial state for grouped track condition types
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored track condition information for types such as sound horn, tunnel stopping area, and radio hole.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for the listed track condition types (group g).

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for all stored track condition information of the types listed in SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.2 c) (e.g., sound horn, tunnel stopping area, radio hole).
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all the specified track condition types simultaneously.

test_cases.title: Single request to resume initial state for Route Suitability data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored route suitability data (loading gauge, traction system, axle load).
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for route suitability data.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for route suitability data.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the route suitability data.

test_cases.title: Single request to resume initial state for Station Platform track conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Station Platform track condition information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for Station Platform track conditions.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for all stored Station Platform track condition information.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for the Station Platform track condition information.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with same validity direction as train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with a current train orientation. Stored location based information exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction matching the current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU where the validity direction of the new Movement Authority is the same as the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 to the new information. Previously stored information is replaced according to the per-type rules, not deleted entirely.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite validity direction to train orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode with a current train orientation. Stored location based information exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction opposite to the current train orientation.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU where the validity direction of the new Movement Authority is opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1. Instead, it deletes all previously stored location based information.

test_cases.title: MA request includes single applicable reason (Driver Start)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No other MA request reasons are currently active. Communication with RBC is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects 'Start'.

steps.action: Driver selects 'Start' on the HMI.
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the Q_MARQSTREASON field in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The bit corresponding to 'Start selected by driver' (xxxx1) is set. All other bits are clear.

test_cases.title: MA request includes multiple applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. An MA request reason 'Start selected by driver' is already active (e.g., driver selected Start but no MA received yet).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a second reason, e.g., 'Track description deletion' by deleting a part of the track description (excluding situations a, b, f, k).
test_cases.assumptions: The track description deletion triggers an immediate MA request or is included in the next periodic request.

steps.action: Delete a part of the track description that triggers an MA request (e.g., situation c of A.3.4).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the Q_MARQSTREASON field in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The bits corresponding to 'Start selected by driver' (xxxx1) and 'Track description deleted' (x1xxx) are both set. The resulting bitset is x1xxx1.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A perturbation location is defined. The train is moving towards the perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position such that the train front passes the calculated trigger location d_MAR.
test_cases.assumptions: The trigger location d_MAR is calculated as d_perturbation - (V_MRSP + d_V_warning(V_MRSP)) * T_MAR.

steps.action: Move the train such that its front passes the location d_MAR.
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the Q_MARQSTREASON field in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The bit corresponding to 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' (xxx1x) is set.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A Section timer is active for a section in the current MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapses until the defined time before the Section timer expires is reached.
test_cases.assumptions: The triggering time criterion for the Section timer is defined in the MA request parameters.

steps.action: Wait until the moment defined by the Section timer criterion is reached (i.e., T_section_timer - T_trigger).
steps.expected: OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the Q_MARQSTREASON field in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The bit corresponding to 'Time before a section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' (xx1xx) is set.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A track description is present. Communication with RBC is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Delete a part of the track description according to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is NOT a, b, f, or k (e.g., situation c).

steps.action: Delete a part of the track description corresponding to a valid triggering situation (e.g., A.3.4 c).
steps.expected: OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the Q_MARQSTREASON field in the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The bit corresponding to 'Track description deleted' (x1xxx) is set.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by track description deletion (excluded situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A track description is present. No other MA request reasons are active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Delete a part of the track description according to situation 'a' of Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.assumptions: Situation 'a' is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, k).

steps.action: Delete a part of the track description corresponding to situation 'a' of Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

steps.action: Monitor MA request traffic for a duration longer than the repetition cycle.
steps.expected: No MA request with reason 'Track description deleted' is sent.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA containing End Section timer start location and time-out value.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving at a speed sufficient to pass the location within the test duration.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting on-board.

test_cases.title: End Section timer time-out consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The train is moving within the End Section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time-out value set to a short duration for testing.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is not at a standstill.

steps.action: Wait until the End Section timer value exceeds the time-out value.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. Location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. Any non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2

steps.expected: The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is beyond the new SvL has been deleted.

test_cases.title: MA shortening when new MA defines SvL while supervising LOA (SvL far away)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an MA that ends with an LOA. Location-based information is stored beyond the current LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message that defines an SvL at a location further than the current LOA (though the requirement says 'regardless of the SvL location', implying it's still a shortening if it replaces an LOA with an SvL, but typically shortening implies reduction. However, the requirement states 'always be considered... as an MA shortening regardless of the SvL location'. This implies the transition from LOA to SvL is the key trigger for the 'shortening' logic in terms of data deletion rules, or perhaps the requirement implies that if you have an LOA, any new MA with an SvL is treated as a shortening event for data management purposes, even if the SvL is further? Let's re-read: 'If a new MA defines an SvL while the on-board was supervising an LOA, this shall always be considered by the on-board equipment as an MA shortening regardless of the SvL location.' This is a specific rule. It means the data deletion logic for shortening applies. If the SvL is further, the 'shortening' might be a misnomer
test_cases.assumptions: The new MA is valid and accepted. The requirement explicitly states 'regardless of the SvL location'.

steps.action: Receive a new MA that defines an SvL while the OBU is currently supervising an LOA. The SvL is located further than the previous LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening event.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information in the OBU.
steps.expected: The location-based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted according to the MA shortening rules (typically deleting info beyond the new limit, but since the new limit is further, the deletion might be minimal or none, but the *treatment* as a shortening event must be verified, e.g., by checking if specific shortening-related flags or logs are triggered, or if the data structure is updated as per shortening logic).

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID

steps.action: Monitor the radio transmission from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an Acknowledgement of Emergency Stop message (Message 147) containing NID_EM = 1001.

steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new movement authority. The current emergency stop state remains active and the train remains tripped.

test_cases.title: Movement authority accepted after emergency stop revocation

steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new movement authority and updates its movement authority accordingly.

test_cases.title: Emergency message revocation acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages. An emergency message with a specific identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A revocation message referencing the identifier of the previously received emergency message, including a request for acknowledgement.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio link is stable and the revocation message is considered consistent by the OBU.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the existing emergency message from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the revocation message and processes it.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's outgoing radio traffic.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the trackside.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the acknowledgement message.
steps.expected: The acknowledgement message refers to the time stamp of the revocation message sent by the trackside, as per SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.3.

test_cases.title: Revocation acknowledgement for inconsistent message
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has logic to detect inconsistent messages as defined in the general acknowledgement procedure.

steps.expected: The OBU identifies the message as inconsistent.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's outgoing radio traffic.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an acknowledgement message for the inconsistent revocation, in accordance with SUBSET-026 §3.16.3.5.1.

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication start based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A 'Sound Horn' track condition profile is stored with a defined start location (Point D) and end location (Point E). The train is moving towards the track condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 100 km/h. Distance to Point D: 500 m. Driver reaction time parameter: 3 seconds.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates Point C (display start) as Point D minus (Speed * Reaction Time). For 100 km/h (27.78 m/s) and 3s, the offset is approx 83.3 m. Thus, Point C is 83.3 m before Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is 100 m before Point D (which is 16.7 m after Point C).
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication is NOT displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches Point C (83.3 m before Point D).
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication is displayed on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Sound horn indication end based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The 'Sound Horn' indication is currently displayed on the DMI. The train is moving within the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 100 km/h. Current position: 10 m before Point E (end of sound horn area).

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is 10 m before Point E.
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication remains displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: Continue moving the train until the estimated front end reaches Point E.
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication is no longer displayed on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area announcement start based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A 'Tunnel Stopping Area' track condition is stored. The train is approaching the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Distance to start of Tunnel Stopping Area (Point D): 400 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU calculates the announcement start point (Point C) based on the driver reaction time and current speed, similar to the sound horn logic, ensuring the driver has sufficient time to react.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is before the calculated announcement start point (Point C).
steps.expected: No tunnel stopping area announcement is displayed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the calculated announcement start point (Point C).
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area Announcement' is displayed on the DMI, including the remaining distance to the start of the area.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area active indication start based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area Announcement' is currently displayed. The train is approaching the start of the tunnel stopping area (Point D).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 80 km/h. Current position: 50 m before Point D.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is 50 m before Point D.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area Announcement' is still displayed. The 'Tunnel Stopping Area' active indication is NOT displayed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches Point D.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel Stopping Area Announcement' is no longer displayed. The 'Tunnel Stopping Area' active indication is displayed on the DMI.

test_cases.title: Evaluation uses estimated front end, not rear end or center
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a known length (e.g., 200 m). A 'Sound Horn' track condition is stored. The train is moving towards the condition.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train length: 200 m. Train speed: 100 km/h. Point D (start of sound horn area) is fixed.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU uses the estimated front end for evaluation. If it incorrectly used the rear end, the indication would appear 200 m later than specified.

steps.action: Position the train such that the estimated front end is at Point C (calculated display start point).
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' indication is displayed.

steps.action: Verify the position of the train's rear end relative to Point C.
steps.expected: The rear end of the train is 200 m behind Point C. The indication is active based on the front end position, confirming the requirement to use the estimated front end.
